observedLimits: The reference screenshots are normal viewport captures, not full-page captures. On mobile the image and long fidelity notes extend above or below the reference view through ordinary vertical scrolling.
The mobile season-one can screenshot shows the retained card but its lower part lies below the viewport; the separate detail screenshot is the evidence for the complete image.
All three source links are visible in each reference capture and their hrefs were checked. External destinations were not navigated to or recertified.

This acceptance covers static gallery display, search, category and season filtering, opening, references and closing. It does not establish combat behavior, animation, an operating motor mechanism, exact episode frame identity or one-to-one artwork fidelity.
